verifiable-quality-gates.why: the whole change is about checks that truly detect: the discrimination tests must run the scripts/ci gate CI actually runs (not a vendored copy), and the new pre-push tests fail closed on a dropped or malformed invoke
verifiable-quality-gates.what: flipped the 11 gate-test resolutions to prefer the scripts/ci (GATE_DIR) copy and assert which copy ran; added pre-push tests proving a dropped invoke blocks and a malformed invoke fails closed
quotes: test must FAIL when the check is replaced by a no-op

architectural-decision-records.why: the three fixes are architecturally significant (how gates reach a consumer, provenance-bound invoke, test-copy resolution) and are recorded in one ADR with the code
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR-0068 documenting the three consumer-install fixes, the scoping of which gates change, and the honest verification limit
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: the pre-push behavior gained new non-happy paths (invoke delivered, invoke dropped -> block, malformed invoke -> fail closed) that were enumerated and committed as tests
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: added three pre-push cases covering the happy path and the dropped-arg and malformed-arg failure paths, following the repo's node:test discrimination-test convention
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment.

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: a .mjs behavior change fired the behavior-change coupling; the fixes are pinned at the lowest level that catches them (unit-level gate and hook tests), not an end-to-end job
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: pinned each fix with a low-level test: the hook tests exercise the real hook against stub gates, and each gate test asserts it runs the scripts/ci copy
quotes: Test at the lowest level that can catch the bug, and match the test type to the risk.

skeptical-audit.why: each fix claim is backed by a re-runnable reproduction, and the ADR states the verification limit (the vendored-consumer end-to-end install was reproduced by hand, not by a standing CI job)
skeptical-audit.what: reproduced issue 2 (new invoke passes, old invoke flags the three reported sites) and issue 3 (resolution picks scripts/ci in a consumer, the skill copy upstream), and recorded the honest limit in the ADR and changelog
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

release-deployment-safety.why: the invoke change is provenance-bound to the published release asset, so it must ship as a version bump; 1.2.1 is a backward-compatible patch with no gate-behavior change for a repo that does not vendor the skills
release-deployment-safety.what: bumped package.json, package-lock.json, VERSION and the manifest version/generatedFrom to 1.2.1 and dated a 1.2.1 CHANGELOG entry describing the three fixes and the re-genesis action
quotes: Every change must be independently deployable, backward-compatible, observable while it rolls out

judge-arch.why: a non-trivial change across the hook, the manifest, 11 tests and the workflow template needs a fresh-context review against the four questions before the PR
judge-arch.what: ran judge-arch in fresh context on the diff, resolved its findings, and recorded the review in the arch-review log
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all of them.

arch-encode.why: no new greppable rule to encode into a rules file; the fixes are forwarding an existing manifest field, narrowing a scan ignore, and flipping a test-resolution order, each already pinned by a committed discriminating test

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no PII, retention, migration, backup or audit logic changed; the untagged-pii gate only gained the same vendored-tree ignore as the other scan gates and had its test-copy resolution flipped

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: no system, service, database or integration architecture changed; the pre-push hook deliberately stays a standalone manifest reader rather than taking a dependency on the aggregator

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: no input, auth, session, crypto, upload or dependency surface changed; the one security-relevant property (invoke is passed with no shell, so a value cannot inject) is unchanged from the aggregator and preserved by construction

pattern-selector.why: no new feature, class, module or data flow; the change forwards an existing field, narrows an ignore, and reorders a resolution, introducing no design pattern

sre-operational-readiness.why: no SLI/SLO, alert, runbook or production-operability surface changed; the alert-hygiene gate only gained the shared vendored-tree ignore and the test-copy resolution flip

universal-accessibility-wcag.why: no user-facing or UI surface; this is gate machinery, tooling tests, a manifest and docs

universal-browser-device-support.why: the change fixes how this skill's no-ua-sniffing gate is packaged for a consumer (skip the vendored copy) and which copy its test runs; it does not change the feature-detection discipline the skill teaches, and no product browser code is touched

usability-ux-universal-design.why: no user-facing flow, screen, form or copy; this is developer-facing gate tooling and documentation
